note: Compositor-own render of the live Qt Settings/Files window over neutral and saturated backdrops. Sidebar and toolbar are sampled separately; the detail sheet and path bar are opaque. The unfocused rows verify the material is focus-invariant, and the solid rows force the non-composited opaque plate.

chroma.note: The measured sidebar chroma pickup is not carried by the alpha/tint preset. The capture rows report the rendered channel spread; a future token/channel transport is required to reproduce the pickup itself.
